scope: Primary repository metadata, licenses, dataset cards and paper methodology/policy excerpts. No benchmark dataset files, reference-proof archives or answer collections were acquired; no problem was selected, rewritten, solved, labeled or frozen.

correction_to_prior_assessment.finding: The absence of a local owner-performed fidelity review is not by itself a source blocker. Published, attributable upstream human review of the exact formal statements can satisfy the requested already-human-checked source criterion. Agent self-review cannot substitute for that evidence.
correction_to_prior_assessment.change_control: These notes supplement the earlier assessment without changing its recorded snapshot or admitting a panel. A later protocol/panel version must explicitly bind any adopted statements and evidence.
remaining_prerequisites: Qualify the fixed Lean/mathlib runtime and trusted worker for the selected source.
Establish a statement-only acquisition route before fetching dataset bodies.
Preserve the reviewed formal statement exactly; bind per-item provenance, imports, exposure and answer visibility.
For answer discovery, define and validate answer extraction against the fixed proposition without importing a gold answer.
Freeze the deterministic selection and shared budgets before scored model generation.

candidates.upstream_review_evidence: The authors report manual correspondence checks of all informal/formal statements. Competition variant v2c preserves original find-and-prove demands and all multiple-choice options. It withholds the solution when the original asks participants to find it. Variant v2s deliberately supplies solutions and is unsuitable for claiming answer discovery.
candidates.card_release_note: The pinned author card says formal and informal proofs will be released later. This is evidence for a potential statement-only route, not a verified schema guarantee.
metadata_limitations: No lean-toolchain or lake manifest appears in the inspected repository tree; actual compatible runtime remains unknown.
Hugging Face /info returned failed config-info and no fields; /croissant failed. /splits exposes only a default train split and does not establish original test/validation boundaries.
Dataset bodies were not read. A metadata/card claim does not certify every field is answer-free.
Joint-success eligibility requires per-item mode classification and a faithful answer/proof binding; a generic proof of a disjunction alone must not silently count as an explicit answer.
candidates.assessment: Promising source for both proof-only and find-answer-plus-proof tasks without researcher contact. Not admitted or frozen; runtime and safe acquisition remain to qualify.
candidates.exposure: Public competition benchmark and published prover evaluations; no claim of unseen problems or uncontaminated model training.

candidates.upstream_review_evidence: The corrected benchmark reports human-reviewer and AI consensus on faithfulness, with all 367 formalizations proved upstream. Its theorem-proving directory contains one statement ending in sorry per file. The four non-proof tasks were removed.
avoid_acquisition_paths: Full repository clone or dataset viewer rows can acquire disallowed reference material
candidates.runtime_limitations: The published environment differs from the current Lean 4.19.0 engineering qualification and also pins SMT/Canonical dependencies. It cannot inherit that qualification or be silently backported.
candidates.assessment: Attributable reviewed source and clear statement-only path for proof-only evaluation; does not provide the requested answer-discovery denominator. Exact imports and dependencies still need admission.
candidates.exposure: Public undergraduate textbook-derived benchmark with public upstream reference proofs; solver access to those proofs remains prohibited.

candidates.license_and_purpose: README identifies Lean/Isabelle as Apache-2.0, informal statements as shared with MAA permission, and the benchmark's purpose as automated theorem-prover evaluation. It supports both answer-given proving and finding a factored numerical answer plus proof.
candidates.source_policy_quote: Do not include proofs as confirmation in any public setting.
candidates.other_source_request_paraphrase: Maintainers also ask readers not to write formal proofs to reduce contamination and to discuss planned subset proof writing with them first.
candidates.distinction: The no-public-proof rule and user no-contact instruction apply. The prior assertion that all private automated evaluation necessarily requires researcher contact was an interpretation, not an Apache license restriction or an explicit private-evaluation prohibition. The broad proof-writing request remains ambiguous alongside the stated evaluation purpose.
candidates.operational_choice: Do not contact researchers or publish proofs. Choosing other sources avoids this ambiguity without requiring owner clarification or treating Putnam policy as a global MATH-002 blocker. These notes do not admit PutnamBench.
candidates.runtime_limitations: Latest pinned source is not compatible by assumption with the qualified Lean 4.19.0 engineering environment. No benchmark files were acquired.

older_sources.minif2f_lean4: The earlier yangky11 port metadata remains useful provenance, but the revised v2 source supplies stronger explicit human fidelity evidence. Source-name familiarity alone is insufficient; prefer exact reviewed revision over a silent port.
older_sources.original_proofnet: Original ProofNet pairs Lean 3 statements with natural-language proofs. Its later audited derivative gives a clearer statement-only route. Do not bulk-download the original answer/proof-bearing dataset.
older_sources.qualification: These comparisons concern source feasibility, not measured model performance.
